## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- `Tests` gate, first attempt exit 101 — `tests/shutdown.rs::sigterm_deadline_cuts_requests_after_10s` panicked in sqlx's `#[sqlx::test]` setup (`sqlx-core-0.9.1/src/testing/mod.rs:227`): `dropdb` of a stale `_sqlx_test_*` database failed with SQLSTATE 55006 "is being accessed by other users". At that moment `cargo test` runs from the F05 and F07 worktrees were active against the same PostgreSQL server (`pg_stat_activity` showed ~15 active `_sqlx_test_*` sessions from them). All other test binaries in that attempt passed. The gate was re-run once after the concurrent runs ended and exited 0 (222 passed). The failure came from shared-server test-database contention between parallel worktrees, not from F08. Run `cargo test` one worktree at a time.
- Service bring-up — the first default instance (started with `nohup` from the tool shell) received a shutdown signal at 15:25:29Z, while the gates were running and before any item ran. Both instances were restarted detached (`setsid`) before Step 6. No item was affected.
- `.env.test` — the evaluator's environment blocks reading this file (secret-read guard), so the gates and services used the documented local URL `postgres://tasks:***@localhost:5432/<ephemeral db>` (`CLAUDE.md`, `.env.example`) on the same server.
- Ephemeral DB name normalized to lowercase/underscores (`eval_f08_2026_11_23t15_22_49z`) for PostgreSQL identifier safety. Tmpdir: `/tmp/evaluator-f08-2026-11-23T15-22-49Z`.
- Tear-down: killed PIDs 2485470, 2485471; dropped `eval_f08_2026_11_23t15_22_49z`; removed tmpdir.
